subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should external plugins receive global model lifecycle and cost telemetry through this non-integrity-attested diagnostics subscription, or should OpenClaw expose a narrower typed and access-scoped usage contract?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but source inspection cannot decide the permanent public API, cross-provider visibility, or trust semantics that maintainers intend for third-party plugins.

options.title: Use a scoped typed hook
options.body: Add usage and cost fields through a minimal typed hook with explicit capability or provider-ownership filtering, avoiding a second broad telemetry source of truth.

options.title: Approve this diagnostics API
options.body: Accept the global non-integrity telemetry boundary as documented, then rebase and land the focused subscription as a supported Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Defer to accounting design
options.body: Pause this PR while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13219 establishes the canonical native accounting and plugin-consumption contract.

recommendation.title: Use a scoped typed hook
recommendation.body: Add usage and cost fields through a minimal typed hook with explicit capability or provider-ownership filtering, avoiding a second broad telemetry source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is most closely connected by available history to the existing typed model-call hooks that the decision must extend or deliberately complement.
